jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the night shift (22u00 - 06u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 21u10 

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Our client is an internationally active organisation with offices across multiple countries. Their Brussels team operates in a professional, collaborative and multicultural environment where efficiency, excellent service and teamwork are key to success.As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a reliable Office Operations Assistant to help maintain smooth day-to-day office activities and provide essential administrative support.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answering calls and welcoming guests professionally.
• Provide administrative support including data entry, document preparation, proofreading and reporting.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, catering arrangements and logistics for internal meetings and events.
• Manage office supplies, kitchen stock, consumables and general workplace organisation.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries and courier services.
• Support facilities-related requests and liaise with external suppliers when needed.
• Assist with access badge administration, workspace set-up and daily office inspections.
• Prepare the office for opening and help maintain a clean, organised and professional working environment.

• You have at least 1 year of experience in administration, office coordination, reception or workplace support.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
• You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is considered an asset.
• You are highly organised, proactive and able to multitask effectively.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy supporting both colleagues and visitors.
• You are hands-on and willing to assist with practical office and facilities-related tasks.
• You are reliable, discreet and able to work independently.
• You are available to work on-site in Brussels on a part-time basis, Monday to Friday from 9AM to 1PM.

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.
Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …),

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for Repair Operators/Body Shop Painters to strengthen our teams.

As a Repair Operator/Body Shop Painter, you carry out various tasks related to repairs and adjustments on aircraft engine parts

• You will review the work documents that contain the necessary elements to perform the tasks (materials, products, technical instructions, references to the reference documents, and procedures);
• You perform the assigned tasks accurately and respect the planning in order to avoid any negative impact on work organization, scheduling, or complaints from internal customers.
• You will use the required PPE when performing tasks according to the rules defined by HSE or the usual regulations within SAESB (e.g., risk analysis);
• You report clearly and precisely on identified issues, difficulties, or risks related to the activity or the product, using the designated reporting tools;
• You communicate the status of the activity/activities at the end of the shift;
• You will participate in working groups to analyze problems and improve work processes (continuous improvement, error and defect analysis and correction, internal and external audits, etc.).

Your profile:

• You hold a secondary education diploma in a technical field.
• You have a good knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts (6am - 2pm or 2pm - 10pm).
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment, and are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.occupation: Lab assistant | Day shift | Zaventem | ENG
jobs.description:
We are looking for a lab tech assistant for a large medical company specialized in clinical research in Zaventem. On a daily basis you will be assisting the medical technologist.

Your tasks:
 

 
• You work in the lab testing areas (EIA/micro/flow and molecular). 
 
• You ensure waste disposal. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and supplies. 
 
• You will scan, receive and distribute samples in the laboratory 
 
• You will do some maintenance of instruments like centrifuges, fridges and freezers 
 
• You will organize the workspaces, wash glassware, creating hematology slides, refilling the consumables for the lab team. 
 
• You carry out lab clean-up on a weekly/biweekly basis. 
 
• You provide support in preparation for client- and/or regulatory audits. 
 
• You support on preparing general solutions as required by the audits. 

Your profile:
 

 
• You have very good spoken and written knowledge of English 
 
• You have relevant background or experience 
 
• You have obtained your secondary education 
 
• You always work accurately 
 

 
• You can work according to the prescribed safety regulations 
 
• You are flexible in terms of tasks

For one of our clients, a company specialising in the petrochemical sector and located in the centre of Brussels, we are looking for a Customer Service Officer. 

As a Customer Service Officier you will be responsible for the management of daily operations in the Customer Service Department and work closely together with 2 Sales Representatives. In general he/she is the interface for the different services within the organization and will specialized for commercial and marketing topics.

Your responsibilities as a Customer Service Officer :

Customers :* Handle requests and claims from customers by phone and by email;* Contracts & files : check input, rebates & additional services contracts;* Follow-up marketing actions decided by the Benelux Country Manager;* Order of new customer cards and toll box;* Follow-up portfolio of customers;* Help train the customers to use autonomously extranet, customer portal etc.

General administration :* Mails (post) and the e-mails on the general mailbox;* Sales support for the sales representatives : invoice, edit credit notes, etc;* Reporting activities;* Back-up of colleagues (customer service, sales officer).

Network :* Administrative help to Technical Manager;* Manual acceptance authorization;* Follow up of fraud cases in stations;* Resolve and help customers on issues related to cards and tolls.

The ideal profile of a Customer Service Officer :* You have a perfect command of Dutch, both spoken and written. You also have a very good knowledge of French, both spoken and written. Knowledge of English is an asset.* You have initial experience in Customer Service, Customer Care or file management.* You have a good knowledge of IT tools (MS Office) and are familiar with CRM systems.* You are an organised person, you are willing to take initiative and you have good customer relations skills.* You can easily switch between different tasks and have strong communication skills.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
For our client, a global leader in roll-on/roll-off cargo handling and storage, we are looking for a motivated Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator.

As a Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator, you ensure that every vehicle leaves the premises in top condition. You carry out inspections, prepare vehicles for delivery and make sure any defects or damage are identified and reported correctly.

Preparation and inspection

 
• 
You drive the vehicles through the car wash.

 
• 
You check that all functions are working properly, including the radio and battery.

 
• 
You inspect the tires.

 
• 
You carry out a thorough inspection to identify any damage.

 
• 
You mark any detected damage for the repair department.

Finishing and preparing for delivery

 
• 
You check and confirm the license plates.

 
• 
You equip the vehicles with a fire extinguisher, warning triangle and manuals.

 
• 
You vacuum and clean the vehicle interiors.

Other tasks

 
• 
You move vehicles to the correct zones on the premises.

 
• 
You report defects or deviations to the responsible person in a timely manner.

 
• 
You upload software updates.

What we expect from you

 
• 
You speak Dutch and/or English well enough to communicate fluently with your colleagues.

 
• 
You have a valid driving license and can drive both manual and automatic vehicles.

 
• 
You have the technical insight needed to identify and assess damage.

If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 
the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 
sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 
develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization) 

• Design and deploy 
Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking

optimization

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands  

That's why this job suits you:

• Thorough knowledge of 
ROS2, C, C++, and Python

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work 

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.
